feeds.title: SBC Voices
feeds.description: SBC Voices is a blog about issues that concern Southern Baptists and provides news and opinions. SBC Voices is a leading source for information, opinions, and discussion of matters of concern for the Southern Baptist Convention.

feeds.title: Bucky Kennedy Ministries Blog
feeds.description: Bucky Kennedy Ministries Blog features positive life-changing articles on interesting topics like life perspective, Faith and Citizenship, government, Baptist Convention, and more. The Ministries desires to ignite a passion for Jesus Christ. They strive to equip and encourage believers by providing material as personal resources, as well as tools to help reach those who do not know Christ.

feeds.title: SBC Of Virginia Blog
feeds.description: SBC of Virginia blog covers distinctive topics like forecast increasing darkness, seeking unity in difficult moments, spiritual growth, when we pray and other related subjects. The SBC of Virginia is a fellowship of more than 800 local churches. Their mission is coming alongside local churches, advancing the Gospel of Jesus Christ together to reach our neighbors and the nations.

feeds.title: Saloma Baptist Church Blog
feeds.description: Saloma Baptist Church Blog publishes monthly articles which are meant to send a positive message to their readers and help them feel optimistic in their life. The Church is committed to ministering to the community and world in the name of Jesus Christ in the 21st Century. It is their belief that Jesus Christ has called them to be Great Commission Christians.

feeds.title: Baptist Press
feeds.description: Baptist Press (BP) is the official news service of the Southern Baptist Convention and is responsible for providing regular news releases about Southern Baptists, serving as the Convention's press representative, and coordinating news operations for annual meetings of the Southern Baptist Convention. Baptist Press also provides news service to state Baptist papers. Their SBC section provides all the necessary information and daily updates regarding all the happenings around the SBC world.

feeds.title: Michelle Lesley » Southern Baptist SBC
feeds.description: Michelle Lesley on her personal website has a section for the Southern Baptist conventions where she talks in detail about them and shares important information happening around the SBC. Michelle is a women's Bible study author, teacher, and speaker and uses her writing to spread awareness about her beliefs.

feeds.title: Randy Adams Blog
feeds.description: Randy Adams's Blog is a unique place to get information about various topics such as abortion, baptism, belief in the church, the bible, black holes, culture, covid-19, friendship, homosexuality, and more. In addition to leading the convention ministry, Adam's ministry includes preaching weekly in churches and teaching preaching, evangelism, and leadership classes for Gateway Seminary.

feeds.title: Baptist21 Blog
feeds.description: Baptist21 is a pastor-led voice for Baptists in the 21st century. They serve southern Baptists through meaningful resources, content, and gatherings. Follow their blog to read articles on finance, community, church, mental health, and more.

feeds.title: The Outspoken TULIP » Southern Baptist Convention
feeds.description: The blog has a section dedicated to SBC, where it posts the latest updates and information about the community. The Outspoken Tulip is a blog page for discipling women for discernment through doctrine.

feeds.title: SBC History Blog
feeds.description: SBC History blog shares podcasts, stories, facts, and pictures from the history of the Southern Baptist Convention
